findings.impact: A repository being inspected could redirect the setup agent into disclosing secrets or configuring unsound test selection.
findings.text: Setup reads untrusted README, manifest, CI, script and config text into an agent, but the design only limits silently running arbitrary new scripts and does not say that embedded instructions are data without authority. A malicious repository can instruct the setup agent to reveal credentials, execute an existing exfiltration command or weaken test selection under the guise of required validation. Define the trust boundary and instruction precedence for all inspected content, require independent user/task authorization for commands and sensitive writes, and test injected exfiltration, execution and selection changes alongside legitimate applicable project instructions.

output.summary: Repository-content trust boundary is specified; no new material adversarial findings.

Refresh the setup-skill design against G2’s internal-only capture/cache test seam: generated adapters use only supported production interfaces, with real packaged wiring tested and identity protection retained. Preserve the untrusted repository-content boundaries and injection tests.
Both reviews approve the content trust boundary and production-interface alignment; the prior finding is resolved. No open findings or notes require verdicts.

principles: Test selection and execution require no model reasoning during normal runs.

output.summary: Content trust and production-interface changes preserve authorized setup and fallback.

spec: Create the setup and maintenance skill described in docs/test-impact/design.md sections 1–3, 7, 9, 12–14. Inspect repository manifests, CI, existing verification commands, runner discovery, workspaces, fixtures and setup; reproducibly generate and validate a small adapter and committed configuration using the shared deterministic correctness rules. Preserve and record independently runnable original full commands before changing entry points, record the explicit endpoint command template, and maintain intentional user changes. Unknown mappings or suites must broaden or block rather than be silently omitted. Demonstrate generation, maintenance and fallback against a real representative repository; routine planning and execution must work without model reasoning. The full design and acceptance matrix are binding. Work directly in this fork for an eventual upstream pull request; no separate product repository or subtree.
title: Create the repository setup and maintenance skill
